# House of Prayer Church DMV

> Foundation of the Apostles and Prophets International Ministry (FAPIM) — House of Prayer Church DMV, an Ethiopian and Eritrean church in Alexandria, Virginia led by Apostle Henok Habte.

Services: Friday Night Prayer Service 6:30 PM, Sunday Service 3:30 PM, and a Wednesday online Ministers Class at 8:00 PM. Location: 3846 King St, Alexandria, VA 22302.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Service times, location, livestream and ways to give.
- [Services](/services): Weekly service schedule and what to expect when visiting.
- [Announcements](/announcements): Upcoming conferences, fasting and prayer programs, and School of Ministry Bible school registration.
- [Children & Youth](/children-youth): Ministry for children, youth and young adults.
- [Bible Lessons](/children-youth/bible-lessons): Downloadable FaithWorks Bible lesson booklets.
- [90-Day Bible Reading Tracker](/bible-tracker): A day-by-day plan to read through the Bible in 90 days, with progress tracking.
- [Giving](/giving): Zelle and CashApp giving details.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from church life and events.
- [Connect](/connect): Contact details, directions and social media links.
